item.title: Show HN: Open-source Dockmagic – Glanceable status display for your macOS Dock
item.summary: Hello everyone, Today, I’m officially releasing my new open-source product—a Mac app that displays various information on the Dock. In the current version, it supports the following features: - Displays the remaining percentage of ChatGPT and Claude - Shows the weather - CPU & RAM - .... Feel free to contribute and provide feedback Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49283670 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
